name: Playback
description: Playback/: the suite's one playback clock (#5077). PlaybackTicker turns display-link target timestamps into elapsed seconds (the first tick after a reset only sets the baseline); PlaybackTiming maps seconds from a start frame onto the frame shown at the exact rate through FlareCore's Timeline.playbackFrame, with once, loop and ping-pong; PlaybackBudget counts QB-L4's dropped frames. SuiteUI's PlaybackDriver runs it on the display link; Flare and Halo adapt it.
technology: Swift 6, Foundation (FoundationEssentials) and FlareCore, Linux and macOS
